## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 29 captures during May 2021. Activity was completed in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

There was 1 ungradable capture. The ungradable rate was 3.4 per cent. This indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable result should be considered in routine quality review. The finding may be used to support local checks of image acquisition and session practice.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This reflects the typical interval for the completed grading pathway during May 2021. The results should be reviewed alongside activity and image-quality information to support ongoing monitoring at Hill Counties Health Centre.
